title: atossa sepium var. subrotunda
intro: Atossa sepium var. subrotunda, commonly known as the Burdock plant, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The plant's therapeutic actions include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral agent, making it useful in the treatment of various conditions such as skin irritations, wounds, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Atossa sepium var. subrotunda include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
